title: Shared primitives
description: Definitions reused by several files: plugin names, people, and the relative-path patterns for plugin components. Referenced as common.schema.json#/$defs/<name>.

pluginName.description: Plugin or marketplace identifier. Documented as kebab-case with no spaces, control characters or bidirectional-formatting characters. This pattern is the documented Claude Desktop accepted set (letters, digits, '.', '_', '-'; starts alphanumeric; max 128), a superset of kebab-case. Claude Code itself only hard-rejects spaces and control/bidi characters; other forms are validator warnings.

person.description: Person or organization. Docs list name (required), email and url. The CLI accepts unknown keys here without a warning.

name.description: Name of the maintainer, author or team.

url.description: Website, GitHub profile or organization URL.

relPath.description: Path relative to the plugin root; must start with './' and must not contain '..' segments (a path resolving outside the plugin directory is dropped at load time).

relJsonPath.description: Path to a JSON file, relative to the plugin root, starting with './' and ending in '.json'.

skillPath.description: Skill directory path relative to the plugin root: starts with './', or is '.'; no '..' segments.

agentPath.description: Agent file path relative to the plugin root: starts with './', ends in '.md'; no '..' segments.
